profile: Front-end engineer with 8+ years across B2B SaaS and retail, remote-first for the last 5. I build interfaces that hold up under accessibility, performance and maintenance pressure, and I leave the codebase easier to change than I found it.

I specialise in front-end architecture: design systems, component libraries and the testing that keeps them honest. At Northwind Labs a 40-component React design system replaced three competing UI libraries across five product teams; at Contoso Retail I rewrote checkout from jQuery to React and cut median completion time by 28%.

experience.title: SENIOR FRONT END ENGINEER
bullets: **Design system adopted by five product teams —** Built and maintained a React design system of 40 components adopted by five product teams, cutting new-screen build time from days to hours and removing three competing UI libraries.

**Accessibility programme —** Ran an accessibility programme across the customer portal: keyboard navigation, focus management and screen-reader testing, raising the automated audit score from 62 to 96 and closing the critical findings.
**Visual regression safety net —** Introduced Playwright visual regression across themes and breakpoints, so UI changes are reviewed as expected/actual/diff images before merge.
**Tech**: React · TypeScript · Sass · Playwright · GitHub Actions

experience.title: FRONT END DEVELOPER
bullets: **Checkout rewrite —** Rewrote the checkout flow from jQuery to React, reducing median completion time by 28% and dropping the abandonment rate by 6 points.
**Component library from scratch —** Created the first shared component library for the storefront and documented it in Storybook for the product and design teams.
**Performance budget —** Set a performance budget enforced in CI, keeping the largest contentful paint under 2.5 seconds on mid-range mobile.
